title: Violet Seed Sanctuary
description: A floating violet energy seed held between four eroded limestone sails by currents that wind around the body; references: ref_04_white_ribbed_arches and ref_07_violet_crater.

review.notes: Round 3 (final) against the round-2 points. Seed: changed, not fixed. The jelly bean is now a lumpy sack covered with a water-caustic vein texture in pale lilac; there is still no bright narrow core and no structure, and it reads as a patterned balloon (closeup.jpg). Fix: a dark violet faceted or ribbed body with a narrow bright core visible through slits, emission confined to the core and seams. Currents: still plain uniform tubes; four of them now run from the seed to the ground as straight legs, so the core reads as a tripod lander or a spider (hero.jpg). Fix: thin wire-like filaments with bright cores that taper, branch and arc between the seed and the sails, none touching the ground as a strut. Sails and slabs: the sails read better and the pink socket is gone, but the floor slabs are still flat placeholder plates at each foot. Fix: embed the sail feet in broken rubble and turf.
